## BMS Reminder Closing

**Import → pilih credential WAHA → Active**

Webhook:
`https://n8n.adbr.my.id/webhook/bms-notifications`

BMS `.env`:
`N8N_WEBHOOK_URL=https://n8n.adbr.my.id/webhook/bms-notifications`

Tes:
`php artisan closing:remind --dry-run`
`php artisan closing:remind`

Jadwal & penerima: BMS Owner → Sistem → Pengingat
(jam + pilih jabatan)

Session WAHA default = `default` (ubah jika beda).
